input.environment: real, uncontrolled — queries the actual ConfigManager.shared singleton wired to the real Application Support config file on whatever machine runs the test

notes: Unlike every other fixture in this repo, this is NOT a reproducible unit-test scenario: it's a live sanity check that whatever real config file happens to exist on the test-running machine isn't currently corrupt. It doesn't exercise ConfigManager's corrupt-file logic in isolation (r3-corrupt-file-algorithm above does that, deterministically); it just asserts the ambient test environment is healthy. Not meaningfully portable to a Rust fixture in the usual input/expected sense — recorded here for coverage completeness (still one of the file's 7 func test declarations) but flagged for review rather than treated as equivalent to the other six.
